name: jackson-dataformat-xml
license_evidence: Jackson base parent POM and project README; pinned POM and source hashes in source-lock.json
input_api: new XmlFactory(new WstxInputFactory()).createParser(Files.newInputStream(local Path)); nextToken() to EOF
scope: Valid XML 1.0 UTF-8 without DOCTYPE projected by XmlFactory.createParser(local InputStream) into ordered Jackson tokens; namespace URIs, root name, comments and processing instructions are not represented by this API projection
family: Jackson XML FromXmlParser/XmlTokenStream over Woodstox StAX tokenizer

name: xercesImpl
license_evidence: Maven release POM licenses (The Apache Software License, Version 2.0)
input_api: new org.apache.xerces.parsers.DOMParser() with http://xml.org/sax/features/namespaces on; parse(InputSource(ByteArrayInputStream)); getDocument()
scope: XML 1.0 UTF-8 document without DOCTYPE parsed namespace-aware into a W3C DOM: root and element expanded names in document order, maximum depth, namespace declarations and URIs, non-declaration attributes (sorted per element, DOM keeps no attribute order), decoded character data (predefined entity and character references, CDATA)
family_note: The native Xerces DOMParser drives XMLDocumentScannerImpl / XMLNSDocumentScannerImpl and builds the DOM in AbstractDOMParser. The OpenJDK java.xml module carries a repackaged fork of the same Xerces2-J code (com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal), which is what the standard javax.xml.parsers path runs, so the third-party and standard Java XML paths share the Xerces2-J parser family. They are separate code copies that have diverged (JDK security limits, XMLSecurityManager, later fixes), not one binary. dom4j and JDOM, logged as leads, build trees over a SAX parser that defaults to this same JDK Xerces fork.
coverage_note: xercesImpl-2.12.2.jar classes carry no line-number tables; the pinned sources jar of the same release is recompiled with javac -g --release 8 for line coverage and laid over the unpacked release jar.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all Maven releases

name: dom4j
license_evidence: Maven release POM licenses ('BSD 3-clause New License', https://github.com/dom4j/dom4j/blob/master/LICENSE); pinned POM SHA256 in source-lock.json
input_api: org.dom4j.io.SAXReader.createDefault().read(local InputStream) returns an org.dom4j.Document; walk Element.content()
documentation_note: Pinned sources: SAXReader.java lines 152-162 (createDefault disables external DTD and entity loading), 386-393 (read(InputStream) wraps an InputSource), 462-496 (read(InputSource) parses through getXMLReader() and returns the content handler document), 895-897 (createXMLReader delegates to SAXHelper); SAXHelper.java lines 84-91 and JAXPHelper.java lines 44-48 obtain the reader from SAXParserFactory.newInstance() with namespace awareness on. Official site: https://dom4j.github.io/
scope: XML 1.0 UTF-8 document without DOCTYPE read namespace-aware by dom4j SAXReader into a dom4j Document over the default JAXP SAX parser: expanded element names, maximum depth, declared namespaces and URIs, sorted non-namespace attributes, and decoded character data
family: dom4j SAX tree builder over the JAXP default SAX parser (OpenJDK java.xml Xerces2-J fork)
family_note: dom4j has no XML tokenizer of its own. SAXReader obtains an XMLReader from JAXP SAXParserFactory.newInstance(); with no factory property or provider configured, the pinned Temurin 25.0.5 runtime returns com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.jaxp.SAXParserImpl$JAXPSAXParser, so the OpenJDK Xerces fork scans the input and dom4j's SAXContentHandler builds the tree. This path shares the Apache Xerces2-J family with xerces:xercesImpl and the standard javax.xml.parsers path; it is counted as a separate package path (wrapper API), not as an independent parser engine. The legacy dom4j:dom4j 1.x coordinate is the same project and is not counted.
coverage_note: Release jar includes line-number tables; JaCoCo instruments pinned org.dom4j release classes and maps lines to the same-release sources jar. The JDK Xerces fork is instrumented as boot classes and reported separately as underlying coverage against jdk25u jdk-25.0.5+8 sources. AFL++ feedback is scoped to org.dom4j lines only.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all Maven releases
popularity.caveat: Summed over 11 org.dom4j:dom4j releases, so a dependent is counted once per release it depends on; deps.dev coverage is incomplete. The legacy dom4j:dom4j coordinate (1,755) is a separate lead and is not added. Rechecked 2026-11-17 by scripts/check_java_xml_dom4j.py: unchanged.
